description: Background plugin that fetches a clicked vector feature's time series (URL templated from the layer's variables.timeseries config) and publishes it as chart-series events for the SeriesChart plugin. No UI panel.

descriptionFull.title: Listens to feature:click. When the clicked feature's layer carries a variables.timeseries block, builds the fetch URL from the feature ({properties.<key>}, {lon}/{lat} — falling back to the clicked location — and {id} placeholders), fetches it, and emits plugin:fetch-timeseries:seriesLoading/seriesReady/seriesError, plus seriesCleared on tool teardown. Layers without the block are ignored. Layer config example shown below.

name: FetchTimeseries
